# pbs_acme_accounts (Data Source)

Lists the ACME accounts of a Proxmox Backup Server, as PBS recorded them when it registered or last updated them: PBS does not ask the CAs again, so `status` and `contact` can be out of date. Deactivated accounts are not listed, nor accounts whose name starts with `_`, which PBS takes for deactivated ones. Account keys stay on the server. Needs `Sys.Modify on /system/certificates`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_acme_accounts" "all" {}

# The accounts and the CA each is registered at.
output "acme_accounts" {
  value = { for a in data.pbs_acme_accounts.all.accounts : a.name => a.directory }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `accounts` (Attributes List) The accounts, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accounts`

Read-Only:

- `contact` (String) Contact addresses the CA last returned, separated by commas, as `contact` of `pbs_acme_account` takes them; null when it returned none, as Let's Encrypt has since June 2025.
- `directory` (String) URL of the CA's ACME directory the account is registered at.
- `location` (String) URL of the account at the CA.
- `name` (String) Account name in PBS, such as `default`.
- `status` (String) Status of the account as the CA last reported it to PBS: `valid`, `deactivated` or `revoked`.
- `tos_url` (String) URL of the terms of service agreed to at registration; null when none was.
